extracted.name: Almond Berry Smoothie
extracted.description: Almond milk and almond butter are the star ingredients in this berry smoothie with almond milk for a nutritious, on-the-go meal that is vegan and paleo-friendly.
instruction_lines: Combine blueberries, banana, almond milk, and almond butter in a blender; blend until smooth, adding water for a thinner smoothie.
